correctness.rationale: For B=binom((b+3)n,3n−1), the C_n block-rotation action is free because gcd(n,3n−1)=1, proving n|B; the adjacent-binomial identity makes bn+1 divisibility equivalent to 3n|B. Kummer guarantees an extra 3-factor whenever 3∤bn+1; remaining cases use Lucas digits. If b≡0 mod3 every n succeeds; b≡2 fails at n=1; for b≡1 and s=v3(b+2), digit constraints force n≥(3^s+1)/2, and the candidate with base-three digits (2,1,...,1) attains equality. Independent exact-integer divisibility checks passed in 1917 cases and deeper witnesses; finite checks corroborate the all-b proof.
